verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar overlaid on a deployed live site is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, so the axis applies. Railway's evidence covers only dashboard-side capabilities: a visual canvas, custom metrics dashboards, logs, alerts, and PR previews. Nothing documents a toolbar injected into the live site for feedback, feature flags, or performance inspection; the dashboard metrics are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
